findings.finding: GPIO0 strap sees the 50 MHz RMII oscillator at reset. Y2 OE = TCA9555 P05: at POR it sits at about 1.65 V (100k internal pull-up vs R45 100k), inside the oscillator's undefined OE band (0.99-2.31 V; floating = enable). Once firmware enables Ethernet, P05 stays high across every ESP32 EN/WDT/panic/software reset because the TCA9555 has no reset pin, so the strap latches a random GPIO0 and the board hangs in download mode about 50% of the time.
findings.evidence: TI SCPS200E s5 + Fig 23 (100k pull-up, inputs at POR, POR-only reset); YXC YSO110TR datasheet p1 (OE enable >=70% VDD or floating, disable <=30% VDD, start-up 3 ms max); ESP32-WROVER-E datasheet v2.4 s4 Table 5/6 (straps latched at system reset, tH >= 1 ms). EN RC 10k/1uF crosses 2.475 V at 13.9 ms, after the 3 ms oscillator start.
findings.fix: Replace U17 TCA9555PWR with TCA9539PWR (same TSSOP-24 pinout, pin 3 = RESET, no internal pull-ups, address 0x74). Re-net pin 3 from GND to /mcu/ESP_EN. Change R45 from 100k to 10k. Firmware changes the expander address 0x20 -> 0x74. Contingency: change R40-R45 to 10k (fixes POR only) and add a shutdown handler that drives P05 low.
findings.margin: Negative: OE at 1.65 V is mid-band (needs <0.99 V). After the fix: 0 V nominal, <=0.97 V if the oscillator's internal OE pull-up is >=24k.

findings.finding: TCA9555 internal 100k pull-ups fight the 100k pull-downs, so the outputs are undefined from power-up until firmware writes them (and stay at their last value through an ESP32 reset). PVDD_EN reaches 1.10 V on the 2N7002 gate (Vth min 1.0 V), which can switch PVDD on. AMP RST and DAC_EN sit at 1.65 V (ES9018K2M VIL 0.4 / VIH 2.05 V). DJ_DIRECT saturates Q6 (Ib 17 uA, Ic capability 3.4-6 mA > 0.5 mA).
findings.evidence: Divider calc: 3.3*50.2k/150.2k = 1.10 V; 3.3*100/200 = 1.65 V. TI SCPS200E Fig 23; JSCJ 2N7002 VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V @250uA; ES9018K2M datasheet v3.7 DC char VIH = DVCC/2+0.4, VIL = 0.4 V.
findings.fix: Same as DIGITAL-1 (TCA9539PWR with RESET = ESP_EN removes the pull-ups). Contingency: R40-R44 -> 10k (0.30 V at power-up).
findings.margin: Negative for PVDD_EN with low-Vth parts (1.10 V vs 1.0 V Vth min). After the fix: 0 V vs Vth min 1.0 V.

findings.finding: Main DAC ES9018K2M (GPIO5) and sub DAC PCM5102A (GPIO12) take separate I2S data lines with shared BCK/LRCK. squeezelite-esp32 drives one I2S data output only, so a second I2S peripheral (I2S1 as TX slave on the same BCK/WS pads) must be written, started sample-aligned with I2S0, and fed a separate sub mix.
findings.evidence: core.net; squeezelite-esp32@ee1720c components/squeezelite/output_i2s.c uses a single CONFIG_I2S_NUM for DAC and SPDIF (l.238, 335-336, 385-386)
findings.fix: Either accept custom firmware (I2S1 slave, GPIO matrix input from GPIO2/GPIO4, both DMA streams started under one critical section), or feed the PCM5102A from the same DOUT as the ES9018K2M and do the sub-crossover in the analog or DAC domain.

findings.finding: ES9018K2M MCLK 50 MHz +/-30 ppm is exactly at the internal-DVDD limit (an external DVDD is required when MCLK > 50 MHz). PCM limit: MCLK > 192 x FSR, so FSR <= 260 kHz (192 kHz ok, 384 kHz not).
findings.evidence: ES9018K2M datasheet v3.7 (2021-04-22), System Clock table and DVDD Supply section
findings.fix: Accept it (ESS reference designs run 50 MHz on internal DVDD), or fit a 49.152 MHz oscillator in the same 3225 footprint, which also gives synchronous 128/256 fs for 48k-family rates.

findings.finding: nRST and OE are released together. nRST crosses 2.0 V after 0.93 ms (tau = 10k x 100nF = 1 ms), but the oscillator can take up to 3 ms to start, so the PHY may leave reset without a stable clock.
findings.evidence: YSO110TR t_str 3 ms max; LAN8720A DS00002165B Table 5-8 (trstia >= 100 us, tpurstd >= 25 ms after supplies)
findings.fix: C47 100nF -> 1uF (tau 10 ms, nRST crosses 2.0 V at 9.3 ms, 3x the oscillator start), and/or have firmware issue a BMCR soft reset after enabling (the IDF LAN87xx driver does this when reset_gpio_num = -1).

findings.finding: Vol-down button on GPIO36. Errata GPIO-3.11: GPIO36/39 are pulled low for about 80 ns when SAR ADC1/ADC2 power on. Firmware reads ADC1 on GPIO34 (VBUS) and GPIO39 (PVDD), so this can produce spurious edge interrupts on the button.
findings.evidence: ESP32 Series SoC Errata v3.1 (2026-10-21) s3.12 [GPIO-3.11]
findings.fix: Firmware: squeezelite's debounce re-reads the level after 30-40 ms, so an 80 ns glitch should be rejected. Confirm on the bench. Optional: 100 nF across SW1 (R60 10k x 100 nF = 1 ms tau absorbs an 80 ns pulse).

findings.finding: The auto-program transistor collector is on the 50 MHz ETH_CLK net and adds its C_ob (S8050 about 5 pF) to the clock load. Acceptable with the 33R source resistor.
findings.evidence: core.net
findings.fix: none

findings.finding: VDDCR has 1uF + 100nF (datasheet: 1uF + 470pF). RBIAS is 12k (datasheet: 12.1k 1%), 0.8% low, so TX amplitude runs about 0.8% high.
findings.evidence: LAN8720A DS00002165B pin table (RBIAS, VDDCR)

findings.finding: GPIO15 (MTDO strap) is routed to the FFC as LCD_DC. If the panel pulls it low, the ROM boot log is silenced (harmless).
findings.evidence: WROVER-E ds v2.4 s4
findings.fix: none required

findings.finding: TCA9555 pull-ups light the LED faintly (about 15 uA) and enable the backlight before firmware runs. Gone with TCA9539.
findings.evidence: SCPS200E Fig 23
findings.fix: see DIGITAL-1

findings.finding: Flash budget for recovery + two OTA slots + NVS/settings on the 8 MB N8R8 fits. Proposed: recovery 0x10000/0x1A0000, ota_0 0x1B0000/0x300000, ota_1 0x4B0000/0x300000, settings 0x7B0000/0x40000, coredump 0x7F0000/0x10000. Current table has only factory 2 MiB + ota_0 4 MiB. Firmware must switch its update path to esp_ota_get_next_update_partition + rollback.
findings.evidence: 8 MiB = 0x800000 (WROVER-E ds v2.4 Table 1); squeezelite.bin 2.69 MB, recovery.bin 1.38 MB (firmware/README.md l.65 on branch 261028-165619, IDF v4.4.8 build)
findings.fix: Adopt the table above. If more margin is needed: settings -> 0x10000 (OTA 87%) or a Bluetooth-less recovery (OTA 3.25 MiB, 83%).

findings.finding: No ESP32 GPIO is free on core (all 24 usable GPIOs are assigned; 6-11 and 16/17 are flash/PSRAM). Recommended source for the new TS5A23157 select: ES9018K2M U10 pin 23 GPIO2 (unconnected today), set by register 8 gpio2_cfg = 4'd7 (low) / 4'd15 (high), tri-stated in reset. At V+ = 5 V the TS5A23157 needs VIH 3.5 V and U10 VOH is 3.1 V min, so use an S8050 level shifter (47k base, 100k base pull-down, 10k pull-up to +5VA) like Q6/DJ_SEL.
findings.evidence: core.net U7 pin census; ES9018K2M ds v3.7 Register #8 GPIO table and DC table (VOH >= DVCC-0.2 @100uA); TI SCDS165F 5 V table VIH = 0.7*V+
findings.fix: Add the net U10 pin 23 -> 47k -> new S8050 base (100k to GND) -> collector with 10k to +5VA -> new TS5A23157 IN1/IN2. Firmware writes reg 8 first in dac_controlset. Fallback: share DJ_SEL if the logic allows.
findings.margin: Base drive 51 uA within the 100 uA VOH spec; saturation needs hFE >= 10 vs 200-350 (20x). Direct drive at V+ = 3.3 V: 3.1 - 2.31 = 0.79 V.

findings.finding: CH340C -> CH340B (C81010) is a drop-in on both boards. Pin 7 (CH340B RST#, internal pull-up), pin 8 (NC) and pin 15 (TNOW output) are all unconnected on U6/U8, which is correct for the B. Pins 1-6, 9-14 and 16 are identical, so the USB and DTR/RTS auto-program circuit is unchanged. Auto-program topology and EN timing pass on both boards (IO0 held 35 ms past the strap hold).
findings.evidence: WCH CH340 datasheet V3D s4 SOP16 pin table, s5.1; esptool classic reset 100 ms/50 ms; EN 10k/1uF reaches 2.475 V at 13.9 ms; WROVER-E ds v2.4 Table 5 tH >= 1 ms
findings.fix: none required; leave pins 7/8/15 unconnected
findings.margin: Auto-program 50 ms vs 14.9 ms needed (3.4x); EN low 0.2 V vs VIL 0.6 V

findings.finding: TPA3118 SDZ is driven from GPIO21 through R54 = 100k. The datasheet allows IIH up to 50 uA at 2 V, but reaching VIH = 2 V through 100k from 3.2 V allows only 12 uA, so a high-leakage part never leaves shutdown. The 100k also doesn't meet the SDZ 10 V/ms slew limit (tau about 0.5 us).
findings.evidence: TI SLOS708G s6.3 (VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, IIH <= 50 uA @2 V), s6.1 (SDZ slew 10 V/ms); (3.2-2.0)/100k = 12 uA
findings.fix: R54 100k -> 10k (C25804); add 47 nF 0603 X7R (C1622) from /AMP_SDZ to GND (tau 0.47 ms, 7 V/ms). Keep R52.
findings.margin: Now: -38 uA (needs <=12 uA, spec 50 uA). After: SDZ >= 2.7 V vs 2.0 V (0.7 V), slew 7 vs 10 V/ms.

findings.finding: The IR receiver supply filter (100R/4.7uF, fc 339 Hz) and 3.3 V output pull-up are fine.
findings.fix: none

findings.finding: LCD_CS is on TCA9555 P17 with a 10k pull-up. squeezelite display_config needs a native CS GPIO, and expander GPIOs are excluded for CS/DC/Reset. No native GPIO is free.
findings.evidence: squeezelite README@ee1720c l.261 (cs=<gpio>), l.341 (expander GPIOs not for CS, D/C, Reset)
findings.fix: R57 -> 10k pull-down to GND (CS permanently asserted, single device on the bus); leave P17 as an input; configure the display with cs=-1 (IDF accepts spics_io_num = -1; patch squeezelite's parser if it doesn't).

findings.finding: BCK ratio: PCM5102A PLL needs 32/48/64 fs; ES9018K2M needs DATA_CLK = 2*i2s_length*FSR matching reg 1 (32-bit default). Firmware must use 32-bit slots (64 fs) or set ES9018K2M reg 1 to 16-bit.
findings.evidence: ES9018K2M ds v3.7 'Data Clock'; TI PCM5102A SLAS859
findings.fix: firmware config

findings.finding: Antenna end is 0.55 mm inside the board edge and ANT_KEEPOUT (F+B) leaves the area under it copper-free (pass), but the cleared strip extends only 2.2-2.5 mm past the module sides, with GND pour beyond (Espressif asks for >=15 mm along the edge or an overhang). The M3 hole H4 is 8.2 mm away, and the PETG wall is about 3 mm from the antenna (15 mm recommended).
findings.evidence: pcbnew geometry: edge x 22.815, module end x 23.37, keepout x 22.865-30.065 y 115.823-140.823, no copper inside; ESP HW Design Guidelines ESP32 s1.4.8 Fig 23/25
findings.fix: Extend ANT_KEEPOUT on both layers to the board corner (y 140.8 -> 150.4); move H4 or use a nylon screw; preferably notch the board x 22.8-30.1, y 116-150.4. Contingency: RSSI test in the enclosure; the WROVER-IE is footprint-compatible.
findings.margin: Edge inset 0.55 vs <=1 mm; side clearance 2.5 vs 15 mm (-12.5 mm)

findings.finding: No antenna keepout on core. About 5.4 mm of the about 7 mm antenna end sits over the board, with GND fill on F.Cu/In1.Cu/B.Cu and +3V3 on In2.Cu under it (all four layers), plus the I2S_DIN and RMII_TXD1 tracks. Expect a 10-20 dB efficiency loss and a detuned antenna.
findings.evidence: pcbnew: board edge x 154.637, module end x 156.16 (1.5 mm overhang); fills cover x 149.2-153.7/154.2 at y 200.7 on all four layers; tracks I2S_DIN x 149.29 y 190.17-192.92, RMII_TXD1 x 149.29 y 208.6-210.84; ESP HW Design Guidelines s1.4.8
findings.fix: Edge.Cuts notch x 148.9-154.64, y 190.0-211.4 (antenna fully over air); reroute I2S_DIN and RMII_TXD1 west of x 148.5; pull the pours back with a via fence <=3 mm pitch. Alternative: a 4-layer rule area x 148.9-154.64, y 188-213.5 with no tracks/vias/fills. Nylon screw at H3.
findings.margin: Negative: copper under 5.4 of 7 mm of antenna on 4/4 layers

findings.finding: RMII traces run 82-126 mm (the PHY at x about 64 is far from the ESP32 at x about 137), unterminated. The clock sim passes (monotonic, ringback min 2.82-3.00 V); data lines are mildly underdamped. Hold margin on RX is reduced by about 0.6 ns of clock skew.
findings.evidence: sims/digital/eth_clk.cir and eth_clk_fast.cir (hwde sim_run): CLKIN transit 1.27-1.33 ns, GPIO0 0.61-0.67 ns, ringback >= 2.82 V, overshoot 3.49-3.61 V; pcbnew track lengths
findings.fix: Preferred: place U9/Y2/J2 near U7 (RMII < 30 mm). Minimum: 0402 22R (or 0R) series at the ESP32 TX outputs and the PHY RX outputs; iperf at 100 Mb/s at bring-up.
findings.margin: Clock: 0.52 V over VIH; overshoot 10 mV over VDD+0.3 at the 0.4 ns corner

findings.finding: TOSLINK into ES9018K2M GPIO1: S/PDIF needs MCLK > 386*FSR, so with 50 MHz the limit is 129.5 kHz (96k ok, 176.4/192k won't lock). The PLR237 supply range at 3.3 V is unverified.
findings.evidence: ES9018K2M ds v3.7 System Clock table (SPDIF MCLK > 386 x FSR)
findings.fix: Document 'optical up to 96 kHz'. If the PLR237 is 5 V-only: OPT_VCC from +5V and a 10k/20k divider into GPIO1.
